title: convolvulus barbudensis
intro: Convolvulus barbudensis, commonly known as the Antigua morning glory, is a plant species found in the Caribbean region. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as reducing inflammation and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of C. barbudensis include its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which can aid in wound healing and skin protection. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, contributing to its therapeutic effects.
